name: OneDrive Dedup Organizer
description: Eliminates duplicate files across OneDrive folder structure. Consolidates all duplicates into root /duplicates/ folder, preserves originals, and generates text/JSON/CSV summaries with comprehensive audit reports.

actions.name: Scan & Consolidate OneDrive Duplicates
actions.description: Recursively scans entire OneDrive folder structure, identifies duplicate files by content hash, moves duplicates to consolidated /duplicates/ folder, generates inventory summaries (text/JSON/CSV), and creates comprehensive audit report.

access_token.description: OAuth access token with Files.ReadWrite.All scope

root_folder_id.description: OneDrive root folder ID (e.g., 'root' or specific folder ID)

approval_mode.description: Interactive: ask user before each phase. Auto: execute with minimal prompts.

batch_size.description: Files to process per batch (default: 50, increase for large folders)

duplicates_folder_location.description: OneDrive path to consolidated duplicates folder

errors.description: List of errors encountered during execution
